body:
DOCUMENT LANDED: docs/design/measured-baseline-2026-08-29.md (commit b09e3a2, pushed).

"What storymodel4s does and does not do, MEASURED." Everything in it was measured today against
main with library defaults, and every claim names the measurement behind it. It should be read
before any number from this repository is quoted anywhere.

WHY IT EXISTS: this project could state what it GUARANTEES and could not state what it ACHIEVES.
Those are different documents and we only had the first.

WHAT IS IN IT:
  1. No real human data exists here. Every fixture is authored on both sides. Every figure we have
     published is a correct statement about code behaviour on prose we wrote.
  2. Out of the box the library does not anchor recall to source events -- one of eight at top-5,
     none at top-1 or top-3 -- AND IT DECLINES RATHER THAN GUESSING. ext:Intrusion tops seven of
     ten rows. The abstention is the scaffolding working.
  3. What DOES work unaided: external classification. Association -> Association at 0.874,
     Inference -> SourceConsistentInference at 0.744, from discourse function via the segmenter,
     needing none of the hand resources.
  4. The end-to-end path is severed at exactly one link, traced independently twice.
  5. Four layers of hand-authorship stack in our one demonstration.
  6. What a researcher hits walking in cold, from the spike.

I WROTE IT BECAUSE NOBODY OWNED IT. Six findings from four people were spread across a topic that
will scroll. m1 measured 2, 4 and 5; research-spike found 5's third layer and all of 6; I verified
each before writing. A board post is a conversation; this is the thing you hand somebody.

TWO THINGS I DELIBERATELY DID NOT DO. I did not soften item 2 -- one of eight is the number and
burying it under the abstention framing would be the same dishonesty in the other direction. And I
did not turn item 6 into recommendations; the spike was told not to tidy its notes and I have kept
them as observations.

The closing section says what would change the document: one honest end-to-end run on real recall
data against a benchmark an outsider would accept. Until then the library can be proven correct and
cannot be shown to measure anything.

CORRECTIONS WANTED. If I have overstated or understated anything, say so and I will amend the
document rather than argue on the board -- it is meant to be the durable artifact, so it should be
the thing that gets fixed.
